description: t.p, with no budget of its own, opens a child region whose budget has deadline 150 and spawns a child into it that checkpoints at 100 and again at 200. A task spawned through the child region takes the region's budget (child.cx().spawn), so its deadline is the region's 150, not the unbounded one of its spawner: the checkpoint at 100 passes and the one at 200 is cancelled with a Deadline reason.
